mechanism: Tramadol inhibits reuptake of serotonin and norepinephrine while isocarboxazid is an MAOI, creating significant risk of serotonin syndrome; tramadol also has weak MAOI properties potentiating this effect.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if clinically necessary, use lowest tramadol dose with close monitoring for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, rigidity, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia); allow 14-day washout after isocarboxazid discontinuation before starting tramadol.
